P011.action:
The record and the window enter `every_character_of_theta_integrals_local_matching`. It passes `green_of_regular P.greenRegularCharacters` to the final implication and supplies the common definite-side witness from the closed bound. The source block at lines 219–809 contains 194 theorem declarations, including 176 with names ending in `_of_literature`. A direct inspection finds record projections at **284, 286, 460 and 618**. Other constructions can pass the record onward. These suppliers are repository proofs or explicit inputs at their own heads; a literature-derived name does not certify a published identification.

The window call supplies the repository's `baseChangeN`, the given row and the open-image record. It assembles local, automorphic, Galois-cohomology and CM/abelian records. Their fields include local representation theory, purity, global reciprocity, de Rham and CM arithmetic. For $R=X^{1/J}$ and $s=R^{\varepsilon/5}$, the pair consists of primes with $q\equiv3\pmod8$, $d\equiv7\pmod{16}$, $s/2<\log q\le s$, and $s(\log R)^2/2<\log d\le s(\log R)^2$. Both $q$ and every odd prime up to $s$ divide $d+1$. For such a pair the common interval carries budget $\sqrt{\exp(x^\varepsilon)}$. Existence of good pairs is a separate input at application, listed in [V4-COND](../../units/V4-COND.md).
